title: Release readiness remains blocked by unresolved evidence and quality gates
title_de: Release-Readiness bleibt durch ungelöste Evidence- und Quality-Gates blockiert
summary: The current report explicitly retains a blocked release disposition while Sonar, Framework baseline, protocol, profile, and evidence gaps remain open.
summary_de: Der aktuelle Bericht hält ausdrücklich eine blockierte Release-Disposition fest, solange Sonar-, Framework-Baseline-, Protokoll-, Profil- und Evidence-Lücken offen sind.
observed_behavior: The current report explicitly retains a blocked release disposition while Sonar, Framework baseline, protocol, profile, and evidence gaps remain open.
observed_behavior_de: Der aktuelle Bericht hält ausdrücklich eine blockierte Release-Disposition fest, solange Sonar-, Framework-Baseline-, Protokoll-, Profil- und Evidence-Lücken offen sind.
expected_behavior: Current evidence must be rerun against a known revision before this finding can advance beyond blocked.
expected_behavior_de: Die aktuelle Evidence muss gegen eine bekannte Revision erneut ausgeführt werden, bevor dieses Finding über blocked hinaus fortschreiten kann.
impact: Release and assurance claims remain bounded by the recorded evidence.
impact_de: Release- und Assurance-Aussagen bleiben durch die dokumentierte Evidence begrenzt.
preconditions: The retained assessment evidence and its referenced revision remain available.
root_cause: The retained evidence identifies the condition but does not establish a product-code root cause.
root_cause_de: Die retained Evidence belegt den Zustand, aber keine Produktcode-Grundursache.
proposed_remediation: Resolve or explicitly and currently risk-dispose the prerequisite canonical findings, then reassess release readiness at exact revisions.
proposed_remediation_de: Die vorausgesetzten kanonischen Findings beheben oder ausdrücklich und aktuell risikodisponieren; anschließend Release-Readiness an exakten Revisionen erneut bewerten.
acceptance_criteria: Every dependency has a verified or current explicitly authorized disposition.
A fresh release-readiness assessment is revision-bound and no longer blocked.
validation_plan: Run the required quality, runtime, protocol, and evidence controls before a release decision.
regression_tests: Add or retain a focused regression/evidence control for the recorded condition.
legitimate_control_tests: Run the unaffected allow/control behavior in the same scoped environment.
residual_risk: The condition remains open; no risk has been accepted by the current user.
residual_risk_de: Der Zustand bleibt offen; der aktuelle Benutzer hat kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: Created by the one-time finding-management bootstrap from retained evidence; no remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance was performed.
